description: This file defines a NewsRepository class that acts as an abstraction layer for fetching news articles via a NewsApiClient. It provides a method to retrieve top headlines based on country and category.

classes.name: NewsRepository
classes.description: A repository class for encapsulating news data retrieval logic, using an API client.

methods.name: getNews
methods.description: Fetches a list of news articles based on specified country and category.
